messages:
kevin: MirrorLake just opened a formal billing dispute. They claim a duplicate charge for April reserved GPUs. Screenshot attached in vendor portal.
jess: Invoice id? amount?
kevin: INV-2026-0402-550. Two identical lines for RESERVED-GPU-POOL (Apr) at $5,450.00 each. They want $5,450 refunded.
mirrorlake-support: Confirmed from our side we only had one active subscription. We saw two identical webhook deliveries at 2026-04-02T03:18:22Z due to a retry bug in our connector.
oliver: If our ingestion accepted both, we should credit. Note: refunds over $5k need manager+legal per FIN-REF-3.
maria: Looping legal. Please provide brief justification for goodwill refund and ensure ENG files incident if platform accepted duplicates.
eng-runtime-bot: New ticket ENG-INC-2026-401 created: investigate ingestion idempotency. Assigned eng-runtime.
jess: Operational steps I'll run once approvals come through:
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_6PLQ --invoice INV-2026-0402-550 --amount 5450.00 --currency USD --reason "Duplicate reserved capacity charge (Apr)"
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_6PLQ --amount 5450.00 --method stripe --note "Refund duplicate charge"
```
kevin: Requesting formal approval to issue a $5,450 credit/refund. Root cause appears to be vendor retry but our ingestion accepted it.
maria: I approve contingent on: 1) ENG incident id (got it), 2) sales gets vendor confirmation they will patch retries, 3) legal signs off one-off waiver. Once legal replies, finance can process.
mirrorlake-support: We'll send the confirmation note to Jess and Kevin within the hour. Sorry for the inconvenience.
finance-bot: Refund queued: refund_txn_b2c9a pending settlement. Automated ledger note added.
kevin: Thanks all 44d. I'll post final customer note after settlement clears.
